subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

Sombre
solution:
The correct answer is: **Doleful**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Sombre **means serious, gloomy, or sad. (निराशाजनक)
 
• **Doleful **is a synonym of sombre, meaning sorrowful or mournful. (उदास)
